captureProvenance: Existing authentic app captures. The 1.0.1 production patch changes timer and persistence internals; the displayed screens and controls are unchanged. No simulated data or AI-generated UI.

slides.headline: Turn the Crown.
slides.alt: Endless Crown running on Apple Watch, with the Digital Crown visible on the right and the Clicks effect selected.
slides.claimEvidence: ContentView.handleScrollChange and triggerHaptic; real captured scrolling UI.

slides.headline: 15 ways to feel it.
slides.alt: Effects picker showing Clicks, Ping, Soft, and the Motion group.
slides.claimEvidence: HapticPattern has 15 selection cases, including Random.

slides.headline: Simple by design.
slides.description: Tap to switch. Long-press to explore.
slides.alt: Gesture guide explaining tap, long-press, and double-tap actions.
slides.claimEvidence: Effect chip and number-row tap/long-press gestures; InteractionGuideView.

slides.headline: Count your way.
slides.alt: Number formats picker showing Decimal, Roman, and Binary.
slides.claimEvidence: NumberSystem has Decimal, Roman, Binary, Hex, Octal, and Base-26; infinite-window rebalancing.

slides.headline: See your spin stats.
slides.description: Session and all-time stats, kept locally.
slides.alt: Local statistics screen showing this session, all time, best session, and sessions.
slides.claimEvidence: HapticStats stores counters in local UserDefaults and the local app group.

slides.headline: A quieter screen.
slides.description: Ambient mode keeps the visuals subtle.
slides.alt: Minimal dark main screen with subdued numbers and the Clicks effect chip.
slides.claimEvidence: ContentView.isAmbientMode and ItemRow opacity/contrast behavior; no battery or always-on claim.
